requirements.acceptance: Lose cancel reply; authenticated lookup proves cancelled with partial fills; record fills once, retain protection and release only proven unused reservation. A timeout, absent REST result or expired local timer never proves cancellation or flat exposure. Restart at cancel-send and query boundaries, then accept late fill/correction without resubmission.
requirements.text: Complete unknown-order, cancellation and expiry recovery

requirements.acceptance: Dispatch resolves current qualified policy, mandate, reservation, epoch and objective; positive decimal venue increments and complete mature costs validate. Remove only POLICY_QUALIFIED at dispatch and reseal unsigned locks; named semantic check still fails. Reject zero tick and mature unknown costs. Expiry/revocation at any preactivation or drain stage blocks new risk, reconciles in-flight effects and cannot reactivate revoked fallback.
requirements.text: Semantic admission independent of mutable hash locks

requirements.acceptance: Real registered consumer applies newer observation revision once, persists cursor/contribution/snapshot atomically, and later eligible selector consumes its fingerprint. Deliver older revision after correction and conflicting equal revision; older evidence cannot overwrite current contribution and conflict is quarantined. Kill actual process before/after commit, replay bounded journal and verify identical logical snapshot/selection with AS_DECIDED unchanged.
requirements.text: Revision precedence and durable causal feedback

requirements.acceptance: One gross base unit filled with 0.01 base fee consumes the entire one-unit execution budget; cash/base/fee-asset postings balance under explicit valuation. Fees, exits or netting cannot reopen entry allowance; TCA decomposition must equal direct signed fill-versus-reference cost plus nonembedded charges. Late fee and fill bust append compensating facts, preserve old decision snapshots and reconcile reservations without automatic re-entry.
requirements.text: Gross execution budget and conserved multi-asset economics

requirements.acceptance: Quantized slices jointly satisfy parent quantity, fresh depth participation, minimum lot/notional, maximum slices, deadline and command budget. Quantity 200, depth 10, participation 0.25 and max 8 slices is infeasible for a one-snapshot plan; never issue eight slices of 25 claiming a cap of 2.5. Replanning uses newly observed depth/time under same grant; restart retains lifetime counters and does not repeat unconfirmed slices.
requirements.text: Joint slice, participation and lifetime feasibility

requirements.acceptance: Reconcile Opus lockout/execution/ledger fixes with canon Jev/temperament/evidence, PR-only Muse/owner controls and their callers; full parity holds. Selecting newer review-input source or main alone must fail retained-feature/caller tests; deleting actual outcome subscription fails later-selection acceptance. Shared-store migrations restore learned state, lockout clocks and account owners; asynchronous Jev outage cannot delay protection.
requirements.text: Preserve source contributions and verify actual feedback consumers

requirements.acceptance: Qualified event oracle, immutable licensed inputs, full trial census and availability-time features support matched objective and whole-account arms with predeclared costs and uncertainty. Calendar years alone are not walk-forward; bid data cannot silently become mid; poisoned-future changes to earlier decisions fail; fixed JPY conversion is not current USD P&L. Failed/pruned runs and corrections remain in census; evaluator changes invalidate dependent claims and rerun only affected studies.
requirements.text: Qualified evaluator and complete trial/account comparison

requirements.acceptance: Selected eligible CEX spot adapter demonstrates genuine matching, recovery and settlement/protection for its admitted scope; contextual app contracts expose exact state and receipts. Mock, read-only HTTP response, chain research or unsupported required attached protection cannot close actual trading integration. Private-stream gaps, API clock/rate-limit stress and account-wide cancellation recover without cancelling manual/protective orders outside scope; unavailable provider remains an explicit gate.
requirements.text: Eligible CEX spot target and backend consumer acceptance
